question: Restricting BOUNCE to stocks already in a long uptrend (trend_age>=200, Connors-style pullback-in-uptrend), do LOWER adr20 stocks still give a better stop-R? Expect NEGATIVE top-minus-bottom, and effect should be cleaner/stronger than the unrestricted bounce cohort.
plain: Combines Connors' pullback-in-uptrend idea with the low-volatility anomaly (Pandey; MAS 2022): among oversold dips inside established uptrends, calmer stocks (lower adr20) should bounce with better risk-adjusted return.
